name: Zerocater
long_description: Zerocater builds revolutionary corporate catering and cafeteria solutions employees love while saving companies millions of dollars as they transition to the hybrid workplace. With its Cloud Cafe, Hybrid Cafe, Managed Cafe, and Event Cafe products; Zerocater has built corporate cafeteria and office catering programs for companies of all sizes from growing startups to the Fortune 500. Thousands of companies choose Zerocater for the customized, consistent, and diverse meal experiences its products offer, while also reducing costs by giving companies the flexibility to only pay for the employees who come into the office. Zerocater currently offers its corporate cafeteria and office catering products in the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, Boston, Austin, Denver, Seattle, Atlanta, Dallas, Philadelphia and Washington D.C. Since completing YCombinator in Winter 2011, Zerocater has raised $38.5M from leading investors including Cleveland Avenue, Remus Capital, Romulus Capital, Struck Capital, SV Angel, Keith Rabois, Yuri Milner, Paul Buchheit, and Justin Kan. For more information visit zerocater.com and follow @Zerocater on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter.

name: Simmer
long_description:
Today’s delivery apps are bad experiences. First, you have to choose a delivery platform. Then, you scroll through dozens of restaurant and finally, you decide between hundreds of dishes. And even if you choose the right restaurant, you might get the wrong dishes.

On Simmer, we tell you the best reviewed dishes across all delivery apps. You first choose your dish on Simmer, and the delivery companies just take care of logistics. Through this, we are able to charge affiliate revenue for every order.

No one has done this before because determining a city’s best dishes requires millions of users to leave dish reviews.

Our unique insight is that all the data required already exists online, in blog posts, social media, newspapers. It just needs to be aggregated, analyzed, and indexed. We have built a custom sentiment analyzer to do just that.

Our vision is to be the first place people go when ordering delivery. 

The founders have backgrounds in engineering and data science from UChicago (their alma mater) and they have both worked at food tech companies like Lolli and Pops and Blue Apron.
one_liner: We do reviews for dishes. Our app helps users find the very best…

Now I'm the director of product at Woflow, which is building the automation infrastructure for commerce.

launches.title: Locale: Unlock 50% more daily energy ⚡️ by optimizing what you eat
launches.tagline: Locale delivers meals made with natural ingredients and optimized nutrient ratios — all designed to improve your energy and productivity (California only).
launches.body:
**TLDR:** After noticing how much my diet impacted my productivity, I spent six months researching and A/B testing different diets to find one that gave me the most energy and mental clarity. Eventually, I found a protocol that worked — not just for me, but for dozens of my closest friends. But I couldn't find the time to cook consistently and no meal service met my standards. So I built my own.

### **Problem ❌**

As a founder, I never had time to cook, so I’d always settle for Doordash meals that made me feel sluggish and low energy. After doing some research, I realized that most prepared meals have:

* **Low quality and processed ingredients** - produce sprayed with synthetic pesticides and sauces filled with processed ingredients and artificial emulsifiers (neurotoxins that can harm brain function over time)
* **Unhealthy oils** - full of low-quality vegetable and seed oils, which throw off your Omega 6 to Omega 3 ratio (key to optimal cellular and brain function)
* **Little to no fiber and protein** – dietary fiber and lean muscle mass are both huge components to regulating blood sugar (critical to sustaining energy levels)
* **Packaging full of microplastics -** heating food in plastic containers leeches toxic chemicals and disrupts hormones

After realizing that the way I eat can have a huge effect on my productivity levels, I started trying out “healthy” meal delivery services. Most tasted bad and claimed to be healthy, but after digging deeper, I realized it was mostly BS marketing with no real nutrition standards to back them up.

The Blueprint service appeared to be the best option, but after doing more research, I found that they just outsourced their food production to a company that uses seed oils and low-quality ingredients.

Every service I tried was compromised in some way. **I couldn’t find any options that hit all of the science-based health standards that I cared about and helped me perform my best.**

---

### **Solution 💡**

I spent a long time doing research (and crunching studies with chatGPT) to come up with a strict list of rules for the food that I wanted to eat. Then, I found an experienced chef with over 20 years of fine dining experience and gave him a carefully curated list of approved ingredients for each meal.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88937&key=user_uploads/714052/e2221663-6c7b-4412-91ff-e4f7240f6c40)

The meals that he created were delicious, and after a few weeks, I started noticing I felt different. **I had more energy throughout the day, felt much less fatigue after a long day of work, and started sleeping better.**

My friends asked to join in and get meals from my chef, and many began to notice the same benefits that I did. That’s when I decided to offer this as a service to everyone.

### **Our Ask ❤️**

We want Locale to be the best delivery service for people who care about their mental performance and long-term health.

* **Have you found any nutritional hacks that have helped you be more productive?** Tell us what worked (or didn't). Feel free to email me at [chris@shoplocale.com](mailto:chris@shoplocale.com).
* **Want to try Locale and live in the SF Bay Area or LA?** Check it out [here](https://shoplocale.com/?auto-code=YCLAUNCH2FREEMEALS). We’ll include 2 free meals on your first order.

launches.title: Locale: Office lunches designed for startups
launches.tagline: We partner with local restaurants to offer heat-and-eat meals that last the whole week in your fridge
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

**It’s time-consuming and expensive to coordinate food delivery every day for office lunches** so we partnered with local restaurants to offer heat-and-eat meals that last the whole week in your office fridge. Your employees place one group order the prior week and all meals arrive Monday morning. No need to coordinate daily orders and deliveries. Employees can grab meals from the fridge and microwave for 1 min whenever they’re hungry.

### **Who we are**

👋🏻 Hi everyone! We’re Chris and Jonny with Locale. We both grew up in the Bay Area and love good food & supporting local restaurants!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73795&key=user_uploads/714052/de350a63-3fbb-475f-a8d5-0732dd859bcb)

_Chris (left) and Jonny (right)._

### **😡 The problem**

When we started working in person this year we tried dozens of lunch services and couldn't find a good option for startups with <20 employees

* It’s a pain to coordinate daily orders and daily deliveries for employee lunches
* Food delivery is expensive and it’s hard to find one restaurant that everyone likes
* Most small startups are below the order minimum for catering services

### **😋 Our solution**

Locale partners with top local restaurants to offer heat-and-eat meals that last all week in your office fridge. Your employees place one group order by Friday for all their lunches for the following week and they arrive Monday morning. Employees can grab them and quickly reheat whenever they’re hungry.

### **⚙️ How does it work?**

1. Employees choose from 100+ prepared meals from 20+ top restaurants. All meals are $11 or less.
2. Since orders are pre-scheduled, we're able to place bulk orders days ahead of pickup with restaurants, saving them time and money. We then pass along savings to you.
3. Meals from multiple restaurants are **delivered together** and arrive refrigerated. Meals are sealed to extend their shelf life. All meals are ready in 2 steps or less.

### **🙏🏻 Ask/Give**

We’re offering a **week of free lunches** to Bay Area-based YC startups to get your feedback and improve the service.

If you’re interested, take 1 min to fill out [**this form**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSckO2DlHw7nZ7D7CprRgDHYIdutqipfRj8V9tdIa4GXg2h6Uw/viewform) and I’ll reach out ASAP to send you a link that your employees can use to order.

name: Sekilo
long_description: Sekilo is building the AI powered halal protein supply chain for foodservice in Indonesia, starting with poultry. The middle downstream food ecosystem is highly fragmented, with SMEs, F&B chains, industrial buyers, and government kitchens relying on multiple vendors, leading to inconsistent quality, pricing, and fulfillment. Sekilo unifies this through an asset light operating layer that integrates procurement, processing, cold chain, and delivery into a single system, layering AI across negotiation, pricing, inventory, and demand planning to automate workflows and improve margins.

launches.title: Chow Central, virtual restaurant chains in African cities
launches.tagline: Meet Chow Central, building Chipotle of Africa!
launches.body:
Hi YC 👋🏾, we’re Tosin, Christopher, and Adeyemi operating from Lagos, Nigeria.

Chow Central is building restaurant chains for Millennials and Gen Z living in African cities who want high-quality and healthy meals. Think of us as Chipotle for African meals. 

Chow Central started as a fun experiment shortly after we graduated from University.  We created a virtual restaurant page on Twitter to sell affordable meals and also help underutilized restaurants get sales during the Covid lockdown.

We relaunched 18 months ago, currently active in just one region and we are doing over $80,000 in monthly revenue.

We have modified our approach, we operate a central kitchen to improve quality and maintain consistency. We then partner with highly-vetted underutilized commercial kitchens to serve as our fulfillment centers. 

Our customers love our delicious recipes and our faster & cheaper deliveries. Our approach of leveraging underutilized kitchens allows us to initially launch in a location with minimal capital investment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73617&key=user_uploads/902934/4b087e33-4f96-45e7-adf8-2811c6cd3e8b)

\
We operate two restaurant brands:

Firstly, 500chow is a high-quality restaurant that serves delicious local African delicacies. Our second restaurant is a healthy grill, shawarma, and barbecue restaurant.

Millennials and Gen Z in African cities who want to order meals online are still underserved. There are over 50 million of them, if we can serve 5 million of them once every month with an average spend of $8, this represents a $5B market opportunity. \
\
Chris and Yemi previously built industry-leading products at Moniepoint. Tosin previously worked at Vendease (W21) a restaurant supply-chain company.\
\
**How can you help?** 

* Refer us to your friends visiting or living in Lagos, Nigeria
* [Check out our newly released mobile application](https://chowcentral.onelink.me/bvtE/t8dfjd86) and give feedback on the user experience (Pro tip, set your location to Lekki Phase 1)

  Want to talk about food? Shoot us an email [founders@500chow.com](mailto:founders@500chow.com)
